isNotice.description: true only for a notice about one lost or found item

kind.description: LOST: the author lost it and searches; FOUND: the author found it

title.description: at most 100 characters, in the language of the post, Ukrainian when the post is in Russian; for a document or another thing with its owner's name, that name: "Знайдено Леокарту на ім'я Столяр Максим"

description.description: at most 250 characters, in the language of the post, Ukrainian when the post is in Russian, neutral, no contacts and no names of people except the owner's name in the title

date.description: yyyy-MM-dd, when the item was lost or found

placeText.description: the most specific place as a Google Maps search query: official name, nominative, no prepositions, no city, Ukrainian when the post is in Russian

city.description: the town, nominative, in the language of the post (Ukrainian for a Russian post): Львів, Київ, Kraków

contactPhoneRef.description: the PHONE_n placeholder that is the contact for this notice
